Messages.Author: Wedge
Messages.Body:
If Byzar w/ Ex Nihilo and some blood chooses not to burn the blood he
gains a counter and goes to torpor. Is the condition for Ex Nihilo
done or must he still burn until he is removed from the game? Can he
then choose too burn a blood? I have no idea you would want to do so,
just asking.

Byzar, 10, AUS FOR NEC OBF dom pre, Harbingers of Skulls, 6, [HttB]

Sabbat: If Byzar would be burned, put a burn counter on him and move
him to torpor instead. If he has three burn counters, remove him from
the game. +1 stealth.

Ex Nihilo, Action, 1 blood, Necromancy, R2 , [FN:R2]
+1 stealth action.
[nec] Put this card on this vampire. The vampire with this card gets
+1 stealth. Damage inflicted by this vampire in combat is reduced to
0, and this vampire is immune to non-aggravated damage. This vampire
cannot gain blood; any blood this vampire gains goes to the blood bank
instead. During your master phase, this vampire burns 1 blood or is
burned. You may choose to burn this card during your untap phase.
[NEC] As above, but you may burn this card during any Methuselah`s
untap phase.
